children: New Delhi: Engineers India (EIL) has signed a contract worth more than $450 million with Nigeria's Dangote Group to provide project management consultancy and engineering, procurement and construction management services for a 700,000 bpd greenfield refinery and petrochemical plant in Kenya, the state-run firm said in a statement on Tuesday.

EIL has previously worked as project management consultant for the Dangote Group's 650,000 bpd refinery and petrochemical complex at Lekki in Nigeria. EIL is also working on the expansion of the refinery's capacity to 1.4 million bpd. The Kenya project is part of the group's expansion into East Africa and aims to meet regional demand and process a wider range of crude, EIL said. The project is expected to strengthen fuel production in East Africa, reduce the region's reliance on imports and supply petroleum products to international markets, it said. EIL works on refining, petrochemicals, oil and gas, fertilisers and infrastructure projects.

title: EIL Signs $450m Contract with Dangote for Kenya Refinery
